notes: Card peaks on ' are' in 'cattle are brought', mal|n|ourished, 'artificially fed', 'individuals fed'; the -pole promotes ' fed', ' maintained', ' kept', '-fed'. Probe: 'malnourished' 0.909, 'kept indoors and fed' 0.740, 'cattle are fed' 0.678, 'chickens are put' 0.312, 'children are taught' 0.237; 'workers are paid' 0.036, 'cars are parked' 0.065. Being causal, the subject sets up the prediction, so near misses swap in inanimate farm objects and non-feeding verbs.
